en: Vintage colorized postcard showing a seaside promenade with metal railing and a lamppost in the foreground, where a few people stand looking out over the water. Across the bay is a fortified rocky hill with substantial fortifications and long buildings at its base, identified in the caption as a citadel. The image is printed in an oval frame on a beige card. A watermark with the website 'www.elia.org.gr' appears over the lower right part of the image.
